status_archive.body: Kernel updates on game nodes CHI-05 to CHI-07, 2 September 04:00-05:00 CDT. Each node will reboot once.

history: Copperline Hosting LLC founded in Chicago by Dale Kessler. Two racks at 350 E Cermak.
Theo Vale joins as support lead (the only support).
Iona Bell joins as systems administrator.
Game Servers launched: Minecraft Builder and Pro plans on nodes CHI-05 to CHI-07.
Chicago core switch failure; two days of outages.
Storage array 2 fails at 02:51 on 21 April. Recovery case 6118 (Mossfield) opened.
Game Servers closed to new orders.
Notice of closure sent to all clients: services end 30 November 2014.
Assets sold at auction by Lakeshore Liquidators, 9 December 2014.
This read-only mirror put up by the archivist. Records for case 6118 kept until 31 Dec 2026.
